messages:
anan_kim: dropped a compact mock for roles matrix on mobile + desktop. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/Org-Settings-Compact-Grid. need quick feedback on tap targets and whether we should hide inherited perms behind a chevron on mobile.

brielle_santos: mobile tap target sizes look small at 40px. recommend 48px min for touch. also long role names truncate awkwardly - maybe allow two-line wrapping on mobile rows.

omar_elbaz: desktop: the column headers in the compact grid are sticky but overlap the search pill when window is 1000-1100px. suggest moving search to top-right and make it responsive into a magnifier-only icon when narrow.

anan_kim: good catches. i'll update the breakpoints. question about invite flow: do we show role dropdown before email or after? current mock shows after which forces extra clicks. would prefer pre-select role so invites default correctly.

brielle_santos: pre-select role is better for enterprise flows where admin wants to bulk-invite with a default role. but ensure the UI clearly indicates the role will apply to the link too. copy: "Role for new invitees: Member (change)".

omar_elbaz: SSO toggle thought: add inline helper text: "Enforcement turns off email invites for SSO-only orgs." want to avoid accidental lockouts. helper should be persistent when enforcement is on.

design-bot: design-lint: 4 tap-target warnings, 3 contrast issues, 1 missing keyboard focus style for the role dropdown.

ryan_wu: accessibility nit: when collapsing inherited permissions, preserve them in the DOM with aria-hidden toggled so screen readers can still read them when collapsed? or better: announce via aria-live when expanded. need to ensure we don't create duplicate content for SR users.

anan_kim: agree re: aria-hidden vs removing from DOM. let's keep in DOM but visually collapse and set aria-hidden="true" when collapsed. also add aria-expanded on the chevron.

brielle_santos: audit log navigation: we tried the left rail in earlier thread, but product wants inline filters for quick one-off queries. compromise: default to left rail, but compact inline quick filters above table when the rail is collapsed. and add a persistent "Advanced filters" button.

omar_elbaz: also add keyboard shortcut ? then type '/audit' to focus audit search. might be heavy but power users will love it.

anan_kim: timeline: i'll push updated frames with new breakpoints, role pre-select, helper copy for SSO enforcement, and mobile tap target updates by tomorrow noon. can engineering review the DOM/keyboard order next week?

ryan_wu: i'll block time to review next Tue. also can someone write the copy variants for the invite fallback emails when SSO is enforced vs optional? need exact strings for notifications.

brielle_santos: i'll draft copy and drop in the copy doc. short note: use plain language and avoid jargon like 'SSO enforcement' in user-facing text.

anan_kim: perfect. thanks everyone. will post updated figma + design-lint fix list. :rocket:
